headings.usage: All page titles, modal headers, and major section dividers.

body.usage: General text, table data, form inputs.

mono.usage: ID numbers, QR code text values, timestamps.

primary.description: Institutional Blue (Blue-900). Use for primary buttons, active states, and header backgrounds.

secondary.description: Flag Yellow (Yellow-500). Use for scanner guides, warnings, and highlights.

destructive.description: Flag Red (Red-500). Use for delete actions, error states, and logout.

usage_rules: SCANNER PAGE: Must use Dark Mode (Slate-900/Black) to emphasize the camera feed.
ADMIN DASHBOARD: Must use Light Mode (Slate-50) for readability of data tables.
GRADIENTS: Forbidden for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
CONTRAST: Ensure Yellow text is never on White background. Use Yellow-600 on White, Yellow-400 on Black.

grid_systems.name: Scanner Layout
elements: Footer: Status Message + Manual Entry Button

cards.style: Flat, 1px border (border-slate-200), no shadow or very subtle shadow-sm.

scanner_overlay.visuals: Four corner brackets in Yellow (#eab308). Animated horizontal scanning beam (green or yellow) moving up and down.
scanner_overlay.instructions: Semi-transparent black overlay outside the scan area (mask).

logo.usage: Top left in Admin, Centered Top in Scanner.

backgrounds.style: Use with an overlay of slate-900/90 to ensure text readability.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on buttons meets WCAG AA.
accessibility.focus: Visible ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-primary on all interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: All icon-only buttons must have aria-label.

instructions_to_main_agent: PHASE 1: Setup the 'Scanner' page first. It is the core feature. Use 'react-qr-reader' or similar library.
PHASE 2: Build the Admin Layout with Sidebar. Use 'Outlet' from react-router-dom.
PHASE 3: Implement the Login page with the background image and overlay.
PHASE 4: Build the CRUD tables. Use Shadcn 'Table' component.
CRITICAL: The Scanner page must look like a utility tool (Dark, High Contrast). The Admin page must look like a school office (Light, Clean, Organized).
CRITICAL: Use the provided Logo URL. Do not use placeholders.
CRITICAL: Add 'data-testid' to all inputs and buttons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use gradients for main backgrounds.
Ensure the app is fully responsive (Mobile First for Scanner).
Do not ask clarifying questions. Make executive design decisions based on this file.
